armor.expression: floorSet = (int)GameMath.gate(0, floorSet, floorSetTierProbs.length-1); Armor a = (Armor)Reflection.newInstance(Category.ARMOR.classes[Random.chances(floorSetTierProbs[floorSet])]); a.random(); return a;

missile.expression: floorSet = (int)GameMath.gate(0, floorSet, floorSetTierProbs.length-1); MissileWeapon w; if (useDefaults){ w = (MissileWeapon)randomUsingDefaults(misTiers[Random.chances(floorSetTierProbs[floorSet])]); } else { w = (MissileWeapon)random(misTiers[Random.chances(floorSetTierProbs[floorSet])]); } return w; where misTiers: Category.MIS_T1, Category.MIS_T2, Category.MIS_T3, Category.MIS_T4, Category.MIS_T5
